previous_actions.summary: went down into Tools > Power Tools

__tool__.instructions: Which action best advances `instructions`, given `state` and `previous_actions`?

criteria.ascend: Goes back up to the parent of the current category, because the item does not belong in the current branch.
criteria.select: Files the item that `instructions` ask about under the current category, because it is the most specific category that fits it.
criteria.end: Stops, because `instructions` have been carried out according to `state`, or cannot be carried out.
